findings.title: Delivery-only runtime and operator proof remains intentionally outstanding
findings.rationale: E54 binds a terminal full suite to the current sealed source and demonstrates real disposable PostgreSQL/BFF/served-browser behavior, but its external boundary is an owned fake. It cannot establish preserved-runtime migration/image provenance, a real approved-template first send, nonofficial first send, or recipient replies. The package explicitly retains these as DOD-11 through DOD-13 gates.
findings.suggested_action: Keep these gates pending and collect their separately authorized evidence without weakening the current synthetic test claims.
